tax.text: Flores says he would provide tax relief and reduce regulatory burdens for small businesses.
tax.quote: I'll fight for tax relief and reduced regulatory burdens for small business owners

debt.text: Flores says he would oppose cuts to seniors’ earned retirement benefits and keep them aligned with living costs.
debt.quote: I'll oppose any effort to cut those earned benefits, fight to ensure they keep pace with the true cost of living

safety.text: Flores says he would ensure local law enforcement has the resources and support needed to keep communities safe.
safety.quote: in Congress, I will fight to make sure they have the resources and support they need to keep our communities safe.

immigration.text: Flores calls for stopping illegal crossings and denying taxpayer-funded health care to undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: We need to stop illegal crossings, stop fentanyl and gun trafficking, and stop illegals from taking advantage of taxpayer-funded healthcare.

energy.text: Flores says he would defend existing energy jobs.
energy.quote: This race is about putting America First, securing our border, defending our energy jobs, and fighting for our values without apology!

voting.text: Flores' campaign supports requiring proof of U.S. citizenship to register for federal elections.
voting.quote: The SAVE Act simply ensures that only eligible United States citizens vote in federal elections. That is not extreme. That is basic accountability.

debt.text: Espinoza calls for expanding Medicare to eliminate premiums and copays and add vision, hearing, dental, and prescription coverage.
debt.quote: Improve and expand Medicare for All, with no co-pays or premiums, including free vision care, hearing aids, dental, and prescriptions.

guns.text: His campaign lists common-sense gun control as a priority and highlights a Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate distinction.
guns.quote:
Common Sense Gun Control

2026 Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate distinction

health.text: Espinoza supports Medicare for All without premiums or copays and with expanded benefits.
health.quote: Improve and expand Medicare for All, with no co-pays or premiums, including free vision care, hearing aids, dental, and prescriptions.
